title: Inventory
subtitle: Every agent, session, MCP, model and identity discovered across your estate.

scope.note: Tenant-wide inventory. The workspace selector does not filter this view.

detail.gone: This entry is no longer in the catalog.
detail.noProjection: No additional details are available to display for this entry. This does not establish whether it has relations.

aiDiscovery.unregistered_at_discovery: Unregistered at discovery. This AI endpoint was new to inventory; its current governance is unknown. Coverage is limited to the configured proxy log and AI hosts.
aiDiscovery.unknown: AI endpoint observed. Its governance is unknown. Coverage is limited to the configured proxy log and AI hosts.

freshness.title: Catalog freshness
freshness.independent: Catalog freshness and observation history are independent reads, not one atomic snapshot.
freshness.storedHint: Active and stale are stored catalog states. They are not health, availability, or source coverage.
freshness.sourceOccurredUnknown: The source did not declare an occurrence instant.
freshness.occurrenceHint: This counts catalog materializations for the entity. It is not a receipt count, matching-fact deliveries, or a coverage total.

history.title: Observation history
history.coverageUnknown: This history does not establish source coverage, completeness of discovery, or current health.
history.empty: No stored receipts are available. That does not prove this entity was never observed.
history.sourceOccurredUnknown: The source did not declare an occurrence instant.
history.firstReceived: First reception of the retained facts
history.lastReceived: Last delivery with the retained facts
history.conflictYes: A redelivery with different facts is retained. This does not count or date those variants.
history.malformed: This observation page cannot be shown. A missing item list, a continuation without a usable cursor, or a cursor that did not advance is an error, not an empty history.

topology.note: Estate composition by kind. Runtime usage (which agent runs which model/MCP) appears in Sessions; resource access (R/RW) in the Access map.
topology.emptyHint: As connectors report activity, your estate is cataloged here.
topology.countsAreLoaded: Counts are of loaded items on this page, not of the whole estate.

catalog.title: No estate entities discovered yet
catalog.description: Entities appear as connector observations report agents, sessions, identities, MCP capabilities, models, providers, or resources.

coverage.title: Collection coverage
coverage.intro: Reads the collection evidence of one opened source registration. Enter the selectors of the registration the runtime currently has open: an older selector reads that historical selection, not the current roster.

form.sourceIdHint: The persistent ID of the source roster row, not its name.
form.sourceRevisionHint: The roster revision the runtime opened for this registration.
form.environmentRefHint: The execution environment that applied the registration.

coverage.idle: Enter a source ID, source revision and environment reference to read collection coverage. Nothing is read until all three are valid.
coverage.scopeNote: Coverage describes this registration and its query over the observed interval. It is not a global estate snapshot and not a provider authorization. Empty completion does not delete resources.
coverage.hasMore: The response reports more pages. That is a list continuation flag, not evidence of collection completeness. This selection has at most one head.
coverage.unknownNote: Unknown means the stored evidence does not establish coverage for this selection. An unmatched selection reads as unknown, never as none or as inherited completeness.

current.title: Current collection evidence
current.projectionHint: Queued members stay pending until their receipt commits. Enumeration alone does not qualify them.
current.expectedOpen: Not recorded until the host closes the run.
current.noRun: No collection run is recorded for this selection. Unknown coverage is not zero: it does not say whether the source holds resources.
current.emptyComplete: This run completed with no members. Empty completion does not delete resources from the catalog.

lastQualified.title: Last qualified success
lastQualified.note: Historical qualification for this exact registration and scope. It is separate from the current enumeration, and later rejection evidence does not rewrite it.
lastQualified.absent: No qualified success is reported for this registration and scope. It is absent until a run qualifies, and its absence says nothing about the current run.

error.invalid: The engine refused this selection. Source ID and environment reference must be nonempty and at most 128 bytes, and source revision must be a positive whole number.
error.suspended: This tenant's service is suspended or not in service, so collection coverage cannot be read.
